evidence.detail: The class is hard-wired to configs/wandering_merchant.yaml with compiled counterpart configs/w.bin.
It walks nested config sections under the exact key items, extracts integer id values and builds a static integer item-id set, with item-definition normalization for one linked-item case.
The Client constructs and loads this config class directly during startup.
Item hover rendering tests the loaded item-id set and, when the corresponding tooltip feature is enabled, appends the exact marker string " <img=370>" to matching item text.

proposals.note: WanderingMerchantItemConfigLoader is the conservative semantic name for the exact wandering_merchant.yaml/w.bin item-set loader. It does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.

evidence.detail: The class is hard-wired to configs/maps.yaml with compiled counterpart configs/m.bin.
Its per-entry decoder recognizes id, map, land, type, osid, group, forceroof and forceroofs, populating map/land index arrays plus OSRS, grouping and roof metadata.
R24 OnDemandFetcher constructs this class during its cache/map-index initialization and passes its four map-index arrays directly into the loader.
The Client and OnDemandFetcher consume the loader's configured map groups and OSRS/map-id sets to choose map archives, group regions and switch OSRS map handling.

proposals.note: MapConfigLoader is the conservative semantic name for the exact maps.yaml/m.bin map-index/config loader. It does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
